general.english_requirement: FYTGS 校级统一要求（fytgs.hkust.edu.hk/adm-req；6 个项目 2027/28 目录页 English Language Admission Requirements 逐字相同）：TOEFL Internet-based Test (iBT) 80（2026-01-21 前考试）/ 4.5（2026-01-21 起考试）；TOEFL Paper-based Test (pBT) 550；TOEFL Revised Paper-delivered Test 60（Reading、Listening、Writing 三部分总分）；IELTS (Academic Module) 总分 6.5 且各单项 5.5；成绩须为单次考试（one single attempt），不接受 Test at home option；母语为英语，或本科（或同等学历）由英文授课院校颁发者可免交。注：官网「4.5」为页面原文（疑对应新版托福评分制），官网未作解释，照录不改写。
general.application_open: 2026-09-01（FYTGS 2027/28 Fall 统一申请开放日；学期开始 2027-09-01）。HKUST Business School 另设 2027/28 Priority Round：2026-07-02 10:00 – 2026-08-15（适用项目含 MSc in Business Analytics），regular admission cycle 自 2026-09-01 开始；申请系统 2026-08-16 临时维护、2026-09-01 重开。
notes: 适用入学季：官网已发布 2027/28 研究生课程目录且 FYTGS 2027/28 申请已开放，本批资料以 2027/28 为准；prog-crs 目录总览同时注明「The curriculum for 2027/28 Fall Term entry is subject to review」。

学费口径：6 个项目的官方 Program Fee 均未按 local / non-local 分列，为统一项目费；是否另有 non-local 差异化收费待核实。切勿混用 2026/27 学费（全日制 BDT 2026/27 HK$330,000 → 2027/28 HK$350,000；BA HK$395,000 → HK$415,000；MAFM HK$250,000 → HK$300,000）。

MSc in Artificial Intelligence（MSc(AI)）为近年新开项目：2024/25 课程目录返回 Page Not Found，2025/26 目录首次出现，HKUST 官方活动日历 2024-09-27 说明称其为「HKUST's new Master of Science (MSc) program in Artificial Intelligence」、由 Department of Computer Science and Engineering 开设。首届入学年份官网无明文，依据目录推断为 2025/26 → 待核实。

MSc in AI and Entrepreneurship 已变 MEng：CSE 系官网 www.cse.hkust.edu.hk/pg/ 仍列「Master of Science (MSc) Program in AI and Entrepreneurship / MSc(AIE)」并链接 2026/27 目录，但 2027/28 目录为「Master of Engineering in AI and Entrepreneurship」（MEng(AIE)，2 年全日制，HK$540,000）。系页面未同步，勿按 MSc 写入。

MSc in Robotics and Embodied AI 不招生：2027/28 目录 msc-meng-reai 的 Remarks 明确写「MSc program is not open for admission」，仅 MEng in Robotics and Embodied AI 招生，由 Department of Electronic and Computer Engineering 与 Department of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering 合办。
HKUST 官网未见名为「MSc in Data Science」的授课型硕士；「Data Science and Technology (DSCT)」是 2018 年秋首招的本科专业（由 School of Engineering 与 School of Science 合办），勿当作硕士项目。相关授课硕士为 MSc(BDT)、MSc(DDM)、MSc(BA)、MSc(MAFM) 等。

跨学科 / 新学院调整：Interdisciplinary Programs Office (IPO) 于 2023 年 7 月升格为 Academy of Interdisciplinary Studies（AIS，跨学科学院），2024 年 7 月增设 Division of Arts and Machine Creativity，现设五个学部；学校整体为「四大学院 + AIS」及 HKUST 2.0「Unified HKUST, Complementary Campuses」双校区框架。本次 6 个项目在 2027/28 目录中仍归属 School of Engineering / School of Science / School of Business and Management 传统院系，未并入 AIS 或新学院。
HKUST 与 HKUST(GZ) 为财务与法律上分离的实体但学术协同（HKUST 2.0）；本批资料仅覆盖香港清水湾校区项目，勿混入广州校区项目。
FYTGS 统一语言要求（见 english_requirement）与统一申请开放日 2026-09-01 为全库默认值；个别项目页未单列语言或开放日期时须写明「援引校级要求 / 援引 FYTGS 时间线」。
non-local 定义（FYTGS 目录 APPLICATION 页脚）：持 (i) student visa / entry permit；(ii) IANG 签证；(iii) 签发时年满 18 岁的 dependent visa / entry permit 者。多数项目 non-local 与 local 申请截止日期相同。

页面状态滞后：CSE 系官网授课型项目链接仍指向 2026/27 目录；mafm.hkust.edu.hk/admission-information 仍显示 2026/27 Intake；msba.hkust.edu.hk/admission 返回 Incorrect Page Access。字段一律以 2027/28 目录与已更新的项目页为准，冲突写入各项目 verification.conflicts。
历史改名：MSc in Financial Mathematics 在 2010/11 目录名为「MSc in Mathematics (Financial Mathematics and Statistics)」，2013/14 起已改为现名；属历史改名，非近年调整，2027/28 名称稳定，无停办或合并。
易混淆简称：MSc in Financial Mathematics 的官网 Program Short Name 为 MSc(MAFM)，非 MSc(FM)；MSc in Data-Driven Modeling 官方中文 Award Title 为「理學碩士（數據建模）」，物理系文章标题亦曾用「MSc in Data Driven Modeling」（无连字符）。

highlights: 官网 2027/28 目录 Introduction：「Jointly offered by the Departments of Computer Science and Engineering and Mathematics」「integrates different disciplines together to allow students to know all the important aspects of the big data」。
SENG 项目页 Distinct Features：「First of its kind in Hong Kong and has been a leader among many similar programs in the region」。
SENG 项目页 Distinct Features：「Well balance between the foundations of the subjects and popular topics with state-of-the-art knowledge」。
SENG 项目页 Distinct Features：「Hands-on independent project with industry partners engaging students with practical applications for future career or PhD study」。

2027/28 目录 Learning Outcomes：「Identify, explain, and use Big Data infrastructure」「Derive knowledge and strategies from Big Data analytics and apply them to privacy protection and policy making」「Investigate existing problems on Big Data and conduct original Big Data research」。

课程覆盖面（SENG 项目页）：infrastructure、data integration、storage、modeling and management、computing systems、analytic and mining systems、security、policy and social implications、human factors、big data applications (data science)。
career: SENG 项目页 Career Prospect 职位：Data Analyst、Data Engineer、Database Administrator、Data Scientist、Machine Learning Engineer、Statistician、Business Analyst。
SENG 项目页 Career Prospect 行业：e-commerce、education、finance、healthcare、media and entertainment、retail、travel、telecom。
SENG 项目页：多数毕业生在原籍国的金融或科技公司就业，部分留港；部分继续在 HKUST 或其他大学攻读 PhD。
writing_hooks: 呼应官网「Jointly offered by the Departments of Computer Science and Engineering and Mathematics」与「integrates different disciplines」，文书应同时呈现计算机与数学两条能力主线，而非只写编程或工具使用。
呼应 Learning Outcomes「Derive knowledge and strategies from Big Data analytics and apply them to privacy protection and policy making」，可用具体项目说明对数据治理、隐私保护与政策影响的理解。
呼应「Hands-on independent project with industry partners ... for future career or PhD study」，需明确毕业去向是就业还是读博，并让科研/实习经历与该路径一致。
呼应入学要求「Applicants with a bachelor's degree in other disciplines must have relevant working experience in IT and Mathematics related fields」，跨专业申请者须量化说明该 IT / 数学相关工作经验。

conflicts: 2027/28 目录学费为全日制 HK$350,000 / 兼读制 HK$290,000，2026/27 目录为全日制 HK$330,000 / 兼读制 HK$290,000；对应不同入学季，本文件仅采用 2027/28。
CSE 系官网 www.cse.hkust.edu.hk/pg/ 的 Program Catalog 链接仍指向 2026/27 目录，未同步 2027/28。

highlights: SENG 项目页 Overview：「designed for those who wish to obtain broad-based and leading-edge skills in Information Technology and provides students with a strong theoretical foundation in all areas of IT」。

呼应 Learning Outcomes「Apply the latest computing and software development tools and techniques, especially state-of-the-art techniques that are used in industrial practice」，用具体工业级项目说明跟进主流技术的能力。
呼应「Subject to the approval of the Program Director, students may take a maximum of 3 credits of MSBD courses from the MSc Program in Big Data Technology」，可写明跨选 MSc(BDT) 课程的计划，体现跨项目学习视野。

curriculum.structure: 36 学分 = Required Courses 至少 27 学分 + Elective Courses 最多 9 学分；选修可为数学系 4000 级以上课程、系外 5000 级以上课程及 / 或 MAFS 6100；兼读制每学期最多 9 学分
core: MAFS 5010 Stochastic Calculus
MAFS 5020 Advanced Probability and Statistics
MAFS 5030 Quantitative Modeling of Derivatives Securities
MAFS 5040 Quantitative Methods for Fixed-Income Instruments
MAFS 5130 Quantitative Analysis of Financial Time Series
MAFS 5140 Statistical Methods in Quantitative Finance
MAFS 5210 Mathematical Models of Investment
MAFS 5220 Quantitative Risk Management
MAFS 5240 Software Development with C++ for Quantitative Finance
MAFS 5270 Mathematical Market Microstructure
MAFS 5280 Financial Markets in Hong Kong and China
MAFS 5310 Portfolio Optimization: Theory and Application
MAFS 5340 Machine Learning and Its Applications
MAFS 5360 Computing for Finance in Python
electives: 待核实：2027/28 目录 Elective Courses 仅写「Up to 9 credits；The elective courses can be any mathematics courses at 4000-level or above, or any courses outside the department at 5000-level or above, and/or MAFS 6100」，未逐门列出选修课名

highlights: 2027/28 目录 Introduction：「Financial mathematics is an amalgam of mathematics, statistics, finance theory and computer science」。
2027/28 目录 Introduction：「The MSc program is continuously enhanced with new courses in machine learning and Blockchain technology, among others, to connect to emerging trends in quantitative finance」。

2027/28 目录 Learning Outcomes：「Design and evaluate quantitative models for derivatives pricing, portfolio management and trading strategies」「Formulate appropriate risk monitoring procedures ... perform effective scenario simulation using statistical techniques in risk assessment」「Devise computer systems for analysis of financial data」。
项目页 Admission Information：「looking for candidates with a solid background in undergraduate-level mathematics, statistics, finance, and computing」。
历史改名：2010/11 目录名为「MSc in Mathematics (Financial Mathematics and Statistics)」，2013/14 起为「MSc Program in Financial Mathematics」；2027/28 名称稳定，无停办或合并。
career: 项目官网 Placement Statistics（旧届别数据，对应 Cohort 2014/15、2015/16、2018/19，非 2026/27 或 2027/28）：2018/19 届平均首年薪资 HKD 342,976、中位数 233,472、最高 840,000。

Job function（2018/19 届）：Risk Management 22.37%、Trading Support & Strategy 21.05%、Quantitative Analyst 21.05%、Investment Banking 7.89%、System Developer 7.89%、Management Trainee 6.58%、Auditing & Model Validation 3.95%、Investment Management 2.63%。
项目官网岗位描述：analyst、trading assistant、consultant，分布于 banking、consultancy、investment banking、asset management、insurance、information technology；部分加入 financial technology firms 任 system developers。

项目官网雇主名单：Agricultural Bank of China、Bank of Communications、China CITIC Bank、China Construction Bank、Citi group、HSBC、Hang Seng Bank、ICBC、Nomura、J.P. Morgan、Societe Generale、Standard Chartered Bank、UBS、DBS、Deloitte、Ernst & Young、KPMG、PricewaterhouseCoopers、China Galaxy Securities、CICC、China Securities (International)、Huatai Financial Holding、HKEX、Magnum Research Limited、Manulife、ASTRI、Numerix。
writing_hooks: 呼应官网「an amalgam of mathematics, statistics, finance theory and computer science」，文书需覆盖四块能力的交汇，而非只写金融或只写编程。
呼应「continuously enhanced with new courses in machine learning and Blockchain technology ... to connect to emerging trends in quantitative finance」，可表达对量化金融新技术趋势的关注与相应准备。
呼应项目页「a solid background in undergraduate-level mathematics, statistics, finance, and computing」，逐项自证本科阶段的数理、统计、金融与计算训练。
呼应 Learning Outcomes「Design and evaluate quantitative models for derivatives pricing, portfolio management and trading strategies」，职业目标可对位具体的量化岗位，并用相关课程或项目支撑。
